audit_revision.reason: Independent audit found that history patch modules changed the shared candidate smoothing vocabulary. This revision restricts the vocabulary to reachable Git history and corrects the descriptive future span. It was specified after the original result and is evidence-preserving sensitivity analysis, not a new preregistration.

research_question: Does fixed one-year Git module commit pressure improve prediction of the next generated Task-module mix beyond cutoff-safe Task-history and Git-history controls?

candidate.name: Fixed-Half-Life Module Commit Pressure
candidate.commit_contribution: one unit split uniformly across unique eligible modules touched by the parent diff

module_projection.path_rule: first two parent-directory components; use the available prefix when shorter
module_projection.task_label_rule: unique eligible paths in the source reference fix patch, split uniformly; no eligible path maps to OTHER
module_projection.future_unseen_rule: a projected module absent from the Origin vocabulary maps to OTHER
module_projection.origin_vocabulary: ROOT, OTHER, and modules observed only in reachable eligible Git history; retrospective Task patch labels never add candidate labels

rolling_origin.block_policy: complete non-overlapping ten-Task blocks; H5 is the first five Tasks in the same H10 block
rolling_origin.ordering: declared source Task time then instance_id
rolling_origin.task_time_projection: use the source PR-created time unchanged as a declared counterfactual Task-availability attribute
rolling_origin.origin_snapshot: latest first-parent commit on the pinned current default-branch history whose committer time is at or before the Origin cutoff
rolling_origin.future_dated_ancestor_policy: clamp structurally reachable negative clock age to zero and report the count

sources.primary_frame_exclusion: exclude every instance_id in the pinned SWE-bench Verified reference parquet

metrics.descriptive: total variation to the empirical future module distribution; future calendar span runs from Origin cutoff through the final Task
metrics.aggregation: Tasks to Origin, Origins to repository, repositories equally

decision_gate.primary_source_h5: candidate macro loss is lower than every control and candidate beats task_full_history in at least 7 of 11 repositories
decision_gate.transfer_source_h5: candidate macro loss is lower than task_full_history and task_trailing_h and candidate beats task_full_history in at least 6 of 10 repositories
decision_gate.h10_sensitivity: candidate-minus-task_full_history and candidate-minus-task_trailing_h are both negative on both sources
decision_gate.failure: retire THY-001R-A without half-life, horizon, smoothing, path-rule, source, or repository search

outcome_boundary.agent_results: prohibited unless the complete Task-mix gate passes
outcome_boundary.claim: A pass supports only generator-conditional counterfactual Task-mix development and authorizes a separately frozen, non-nominating Selection development replay on existing public outcomes. It is not external confirmation or strict prospective validity.

forbidden_post_replay_changes: searching another half-life, smoothing value, module depth, exclusion list, horizon, source subset, or repository subset
dropping OTHER or Tasks with no eligible reference-patch path
promoting total variation or a calendar subgroup after cross-entropy fails
using reference patch paths as pre-Origin Selector inputs
opening Agent outcomes after a failed Task-mix gate
